Quebec Law 25
Quebec Law 25, formerly known as Bill 64, strengthens obligations for transparency and data protection in handling personal information of Quebec residents.

Glow
Glow is a compliance-flagging status used internally to indicate geo-based alerts and to monitor feature health.

Canada
Canada is a country in North America, referenced in the context of implementing geo-specific controls for personalized feeds for users.

Office of the Privacy Commissioner (OPC)
The OPC is responsible for overseeing compliance with privacy laws in Canada, including providing guidance on obtaining meaningful consent under PIPEDA.

jury reports
Jury reports analyze and summarize the requirements for compliance with privacy laws specific to Canada, highlighting necessary controls for data management.

data.entity_name: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA)
data.content:
Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA)
PIPEDA is a Canadian federal law that governs the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information, emphasizing the requirement for organizations to obtain consent.

Bill C-27/AIDA
Bill C-27/AIDA is a proposed federal legislation aimed at enhancing algorithmic transparency and governance for automated decision systems in Canada.

Spanner
Spanner is a synthetic name for a rule engine designed to isolate affected cohorts during the testing of personalized feed variants.

federal privacy law (PIPEDA)
Federal privacy law (PIPEDA) forms the foundation of privacy regulations in Canada, encompassing principles for obtaining consent and data protection.

ISED
ISED (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada) produced a companion document on the AIDA, detailing obligations and updates related to the act.

consultation materials
Consultation materials refer to documents and information provided to stakeholders to guide discussions and considerations regarding the AIDA.

Bill C-27
Bill C-27 is the legislative proposal that includes the Artificial Intelligence and Data Act and outlines obligations for transparency, documentation, and risk management for certain AI systems.

privacy/algorithmic impact assessments
Privacy/algorithmic impact assessments are evaluations performed to ensure compliance with privacy laws and assess risks associated with data handling and algorithm use.

transparency requirements
Transparency requirements are criteria outlined in the AIDA that dictate the necessary levels of openness and clarity regarding automated decision systems.

Artificial Intelligence and Data Act
The Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA) was proposed as part of Bill C-27, emphasizing algorithmic transparency and governance for automated decision systems.

automated decision systems
Automated decision systems are software systems that make decisions based on data inputs, and are subject to the governance and transparency obligations proposed in the AIDA.

risk management obligations
Risk management obligations are the responsibilities assigned to ensure that AI systems are monitored and managed to mitigate risks associated with their deployment.
